audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Lucian 4 stages and Skill 3, with Sejuani winning nothing, while the Emerald+ data has Sejuani at 57.41% over 270 games.
audit.why: Both layers already narrate the pivot in prose ('Level 6 is your pivot', 'At two tank items Lucian's lane identity collapses'), so the chart simply never caught up to the text or the win rate. Lucian keeps levels 1-3, 4-5 becomes even, and Sejuani takes 6 onward.
audit.corrected: win[3..6] and the matching phases[].side/.rating now hand Sejuani the back half.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 1-2 spike named 'Q poke' generically and never gave the range that makes it dodgeable.
audit.why: Piercing Light is a 500-range line — that is barely outside Sejuani's 560 Permafrost range, which is why holding behind the wave works and why his poke is a stepping pattern, not free.
audit.corrected: Spike now names Piercing Light and its range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said that Sejuani's own crowd control empowers Lightslinger, and Relentless Pursuit was treated as a fixed timer.
audit.why: Riot's Lightslinger text: 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage'. Every Arctic Assault knockup, Permafrost stun and Glacial Prison stun therefore arms two empowered autos for Lucian — the single most important unstated interaction in this matchup. Separately, Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s AND 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', so counting his procs beats counting seconds.
audit.corrected: Both facts now appear in content whys/wants and in full's cooldowns and Key Ability Interactions blocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers for the matchup-defining cooldown.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit's real values are 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and it is reduced by Lightslinger attacks.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the reduction mechanic added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit's mana cost falls to 0 at rank 5 (32/24/16/8/0) — a maxed E is free, which changes late-lane bait maths.
audit.why: Not stated anywhere, and it is in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Not written this pass — no edit slot stayed inside the length band without cutting the CC-empowers-Lightslinger point, which matters more.

edits.before: Lucian's passive double-shot and Q poke punish every step you take before your Frost stack pattern is up — stay behind the wave and absorb with Second Wind.
edits.after: Piercing Light (Q) at 500 range and the Lightslinger double-shot punish every step before your Frost pattern exists — hold behind the wave and absorb.

edits.before: Stack Frost on Lucian with W from max range, then detonate Permafrost the moment he steps up without his E dash available
edits.after: Stack Frost with W from max range and detonate Permafrost only when his E is down — every stun you land arms his next two autos

edits.before: Use Relentless Pursuit to dodge your Q engage and reset his passive double-shot to out-trade in range
edits.after: Cut Relentless Pursuit's 14-16s cooldown short with Lightslinger double-shots, then dash out of your Q engage

edits.before: His Relentless Pursuit and double-shot burst outpace your raw damage and he can disengage any Q engage he reads — this window belongs to him until your R creates an angle he can't dash away from.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit (14-16s) shortens every time his double-shot lands, and your own CC arms Lightslinger's bonus autos — the window is his until R makes an angle he cannot dash out of.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget Q dash for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit (E): 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, and every Lightslinger double-shot shortens it — count his procs, not just seconds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget your Q for exits and the R for openings.

edits.before: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: His E is 14-16s but Lightslinger procs shave it — count his double-shots, then go.

edits.before: Track Lucian’s Relentless Pursuit: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Lightslinger arms his next two autos whenever anyone near him is immobilized — your own stun pays him. Land it, trade, then walk.

notes: The three suspectNames flagged for this matchup (Land Glacial Prison, Use Relentless Pursuit, His Relentless Pursuit) are all correct Riot names — false positives. The chart fix is the important one here: prose in both layers already said Sejuani takes over at 6, but win[] and phases[].side still handed Lucian or 'Skill' every stage, which is what produced the 57.41%-vs-chart contradiction.
